original_fields.description: Build scripts and Android adapters for packaging ArtCraft Suite apps as ARM64 APKs from their existing source repositories. original_fields.limitations: Builds ports of the existing apps rather than independent implementations. Android behavior varies by app and adapter; a successful build does not establish full desktop feature parity. The generated keystore is for local use; public distribution requires separate release signing. Source checkouts must be updated deliberately.

original_fields.name: WordCraft for Android
original_fields.description: An Android port of WordCraft retaining its Rust engine and egui interface in a native GameActivity host. Adds touch gestures, an on-screen modifier and shortcut bar, Android file pickers, export mirroring, clipboard integration, and mouse and hardware-keyboard support.
original_fields.limitations: Early Android port; the maintainer calls for device bring-up checks of soft-keyboard composition and touch sizing. Android omits the control and MCP server, native printing and drag-and-drop. Hardware Ctrl+V uses the in-app clipboard; the ribbon Paste button reads the system clipboard. No published release was available at review.
original_fields.summary: Use WordCraft on Android with touch gestures, a shortcut bar, file access and the existing Rust engine.
